decisions.reason: 力量 appears inside the lexical item 力量石 ('power stone') rather than clearly as the gameplay Power stat. Applying the generic stat rule mechanically would risk corrupting the item name; this needs narrower canonical/context evidence.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.stat.power conflicts with the apparent compound-item context, so no confident one-off correction is safe.
